**Invoke relevant or requested skills BEFORE any response or action.** Even a 1% chance a skill might apply means that you should invoke the skill to check. If an invoked skill turns out to be wrong for the situation, you don't need to use it.

Instructions say WHAT, not HOW. "Add X" or "Fix Y" doesn't mean skip workflows.

关于你提到的几个东西，我逐一说明：

## 小米百亿 Token

小米确实有面向开发者的免费 token 计划。10 亿左右的免费 token 对于个人项目来说非常充裕——即使跑 OpenClaw 这类 agent 框架，每天烧几十万 token，也能撑很久。关键是看 API 支持什么模型、速率限制和并发数如何。

## Mimo Claw / OpenClaw

- **OpenClaw** 是前段时间比较火的开源 AI agent/自动化框架，确实比较吃 token，因为 agent 模式本质上是多轮推理循环，每次任务可能消耗几万到几十万 token。但你 10 亿的额度足够玩很久。
- **小米 Mimo Claw** 我没查到具体的开源项目信息——如果你指的是小米 Mimo 机器人相关或某个特定项目，可以在回复里贴个链接，我帮你看看。

## AI 视频创作

现阶段主流的 AI 视频工具：

| 工具 | 特点 |
|------|------|
| **可灵 (Kling)** | 国内最强，快手出品，文生视频/图生视频，免费额度不错 |
| **即梦 (Jimeng)** | 字节系，与抖音生态打通，性价比高 |
| **Runway Gen-4** | 国际一线，功能最全，付费 |
| **Pika** | 轻量级，适合短创意视频 |
| **Stable Video Diffusion** | 开源，可本地跑，不烧 API token |

如果你不想额外付费，**可灵**和**即梦**是目前国内最好的选择，和小米的 token 不冲突——视频生成一般是各自平台的独立额度，不是 API token 计费。

---

总结：10 亿 token 够玩所有你想试的东西。OpenClaw 放心跑。AI 视频用可灵或即梦起步。有什么具体想先试的，我可以帮你规划一下。

# OpenCode: Open-Source AI Coding Agent (2025-2026)

Here's a comprehensive summary of what the search reveals about **OpenCode**, one of the fastest-growing open-source AI coding tools.

---

## Overview

**OpenCode** is an open-source, terminal-based AI coding agent created by the team at [anomalyco](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode) (also known as SST). It allows developers to use natural language to write code, debug, refactor, and manage Git workflows — similar to Claude Code, but fully open-source and provider-agnostic.

| Detail | Value |
|---|---|
| **GitHub** | `github.com/anomalyco/opencode` (previously `sst/opencode`) |
| **Website** | opencode.ai |
| **Stars** | ⭐ 100,000+ (as of Feb 2026) |
| **Contributors** | 700+ |
| **License** | MIT |
| **Core Language** | Go (core) / TypeScript (TUI) |
| **Monthly Active Users** | 2.5 million+ (as of Feb 2026) |

---

## Key Timeline (2025-2026)

| Date | Milestone | Stars |
|---|---|---|
| **June 19, 2025** | Project launched | 0 |
| **Oct 2025** | 1.1M+ total downloads, 10,000+ daily | ~18,000 |
| **Nov 2025** | 650K monthly active users | ~25,000 |
| **Dec 2025** | v1.0 rewrite released; users discover Claude Max subscription routing | ~45,000 |
| **Jan 6, 2026** | +1,852 stars in a single day | ~55,000 |
| **Jan 9, 2026** | Anthropic blocks third-party tools from routing Claude subscriptions (major controversy) | — |
| **Jan 12, 2026** | +2,087 stars in a day; surpasses Claude Code in stars (63K vs 55K) | ~63,000 |
| **Feb 2026** | Breaks 100K stars, 2.5M MAU | 100,000+ |

---

## Architecture & Features

- **Two built-in agents:** `build` (full-access dev work) and `plan` (read-only analysis/exploration). Switchable with `Tab`.
- **General subagent** for complex searches and multi-step tasks, invocable via `@general`.
- **Client/server architecture** — allows running on a remote machine while driving from a mobile app.
- **Out-of-the-box LSP support** for intelligent code editing.
- **TUI-focused** — built by neovim users and creators of terminal.shop.
- **75+ AI providers** supported: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Groq, Ollama, AWS Bedrock, Azure, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, xAI, and more.
- **Free tier** called "OpenCode Zen" — curated models, no API keys needed.

---

## Installation

```bash
# Quick install
curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash

# Package managers
npm i -g opencode-ai@latest
brew install anomalyco/tap/opencode
scoop install opencode          # Windows
choco install opencode          # Windows
sudo pacman -S opencode         # Arch Linux
mise use -g opencode            # Any OS
```

A **desktop app (BETA)** is also available for macOS, Windows, and Linux, installable via `brew install --cask opencode-desktop`.

---

## Ecosystem & Derivatives

Several notable projects have emerged around OpenCode:

1. **HolyCode** (`CoderLuii/HolyCode`) — Dockerized AI coding workstation wrapping OpenCode with 50+ tools, headless browser, multi-agent orchestration (Hermes Agent + Paperclip dashboard), and Claude subscription support.

2. **Home Assistant OpenCode** (`magnusoverli/opencode`) — Brings OpenCode into Home Assistant for AI-powered configuration editing, with 33 MCP tools and LSP support for YAML. Latest release: **v1.8.0 (April 16, 2026)**.

3. **agent-launch** (`dhruv-anand-aintech/agent-launch`) — Unified launcher for Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and Cursor Agent with normalized controls.

4. **nelli-ocode** (`NeLLi-team/nelli-ocode`) — Chat-first fork with plan/completion guardrails and multi-provider support.

5. **SafeCode** — Runs coding agents in hardened Incus containers with real-time network threat detection.

---

## vs Claude Code

- **Out-of-the-box LSP support** for intelligent code editing.
- **TUI-focused** — built by neovim users and creators of terminal.shop.

# Quick install

# Search Results: OpenClaw AI Agent Framework

## Overview

**OpenClaw** is a major open-source, self-hosted AI agent framework that has rapidly grown to over **250,000 GitHub stars** as of 2026. Originally starting as an experimental prototype called "Clawdbot" (2025 Q2), it evolved through "Moltbot" (2025 Q4) before being renamed to **OpenClaw** in early 2026. The project is hosted at **github.com/openclaw/openclaw**.

---

## Key Repositories Found

| Repository | Description |
|---|---|
| **[openclaw/openclaw](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw)** | The main framework — the core project with 250k+ stars |
| **[prasadgaikwad/openclaw4j](https://github.com/prasadgaikwad/openclaw4j)** | Java port (OpenClaw4J) using Spring Boot 3.5.10, Spring AI 1.1.2, Java 25 |
| **[OnlyTerp/openclaw-optimization-guide](https://github.com/OnlyTerp/openclaw-optimization-guide)** | Community optimization guide for performance, memory, cost, and security |
| **[a3tai/openclaw-go](https://github.com/a3tai/openclaw-go)** | Go language port tracking upstream releases |

---

## Release Timeline (2025–2026)

- **2025 Q2** — Initial prototype "Clawdbot" with basic LLM reasoning, Python script scheduler, and containerized sandbox
- **2025 Q4** — "Moltbot" rewrite: Gateway control plane, dynamic skill injection, environment-rooting mechanisms
- **Early 2026** — Rebranded to **OpenClaw** with the "Lobster" execution loop, cross-platform gateway, and pluggable skill ecosystem
- **v2026.2.15** (Feb 2026) — Discord Components v2, nested sub-agents, cron webhooks, security hardening
- **v2026.3.24** (Mar 2026) — OpenAI-compatible `/v1/models` & `/v1/embeddings`, Microsoft Teams SDK migration, Control UI skill management
- **v2026.4.7** (Apr 2026) — CLI `infer` hub, memory-wiki plugin, Gemma 4 support, pluggable compaction providers
- **v2026.4.29-beta.1** (Late Apr 2026) — Active-run steering, people-aware memory wiki, NVIDIA provider, SQLite plugin state store

---

## Core Architecture

OpenClaw uses a **Gateway control plane** with separated data/control flows:

- **Multi-Channel Gateway** — Unified adapters for Slack, Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp, Microsoft Teams, Matrix, LINE, Feishu, QQ Bot, Google Chat, BlueBubbles, Yuanbao, and more
- **Agent Core** — ReAct-loop planning with LLM-powered reasoning, task execution, and response composition
- **Layered Memory** — Short-term → working → long-term (MEMORY.md) → profiles (SOUL/USER/TOOLS.md) → vector-indexed RAG
- **Plugin/Tool System** — MCP tools, ClawHub marketplace (13,000+ community skills), browser automation, cron scheduling
- **Security** — Containerized sandboxing, RBAC/ABAC permissions, SSRF guards, secret redaction, OpenGrep scanning

---

## Notable Derivative Projects

- **NanoClaw** — IoT-optimized, <50MB memory footprint, ARM-compatible
- **ZeroClaw** — Pure frontend via WebAssembly, runs directly in the browser
- **PicoClaw** — Embedded systems/MCU deployment
- **IronClaw** — Enterprise-grade security fork

---

## Community & Ecosystem

- Over 2,000+ ready-to-use skills across DevOps, office automation, smart home, etc.
- ClawHub marketplace with plugin signing and integrity verification (SHA-256)
- Active community producing optimization guides, migration paths (v3→v4→2026.x), and production readiness scorecards
- The project has been described as sparking a "全民养虾热" (nationwide shrimp-farming craze) in Chinese developer communities, with over 2,000 tutorial posts daily at peak
